rationale: T4 (ON-motion) and T5 (OFF-motion) neurons are the first direction-selective cells in the Drosophila visual system. Subtypes a, b, c, d correspond to the four cardinal directions (front-to-back, back-to-front, upward, downward).
known_limitations: Cell-type labels identify anatomical populations in the optic lobe; specific receptive-field tuning coordinates require spatial column alignment.

rationale: Mi1 and Tm3 interneurons in the medulla provide spatially and temporally segregated presynaptic inputs to T4 dendrites to implement the Hassenstein-Reichardt elementary motion detector correlator.
known_limitations: Synaptic weight distributions vary across individual retinotopic columns; connectome reflects traced subset.

rationale: DNp01 is the systematic cell-type name for the Giant Fiber (GF) descending neuron, which synapses directly onto TTMn (tergotrochanteral motor neuron) in the VNC to trigger jump muscle contraction during flight initiation.
known_limitations: Only two bilateral DNp01 neurons exist in the CNS (DNp01_L and DNp01_R); electrical gap junctions are not quantified in EM chemical synapse weights.

rationale: Lobula Columnar 4 (LC4) visual projection neurons respond preferentially to looming optical stimuli (rapidly expanding dark silhouettes) and project to the posterior slope to converge onto descending escape circuits.
known_limitations: LC4 populations contain hundreds of visual columnar units with differing visual field coordinates.

rationale: Projection neurons from specific antennal lobe glomeruli (e.g. DA1 for pheromone cis-vaccenyl acetate, DL3/DM1 for food odors) relay odorant representations to higher brain centers.
known_limitations: Antennal lobe sensory receptor neurons (ORNs) entering from the antennae are largely truncated at the antennal nerve in this traced CNS subset.

rationale: Distal medulla neurons Dm8 and Dm9 integrate ultraviolet and blue/green signals from R7 and R8 photoreceptors for spectral comparison.
known_limitations: Photoreceptor axons in the retina and superficial medulla are not fully traced in the central-brain connectome weights subset.

rationale: Antennal mechanosensory and motor center (AMMC) interneurons process Johnson's organ chordotonal organ acoustic vibrations (courtship song pulses).
known_limitations: Specific AMMC subtype labels in MaleCNS v1.0 have partial annotations; chordotonal primary afferents are not systematically labeled in this dataset version.
